北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京的朋友，天冷体感更低，记得多穿衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it feels even colder, remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴冷潮湿，体感低，注意防寒，小心湿滑路面。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is damp and chilly, feels cold. Stay warm and watch for slippery roads.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴沉微冷，体感 0℃，出门记得添衣保暖，别着凉啦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cool, feels like 0℃. Don't forget to layer up!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云暖和，记得多喝水，防晒轻松出行！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm, remember to hydrate and enjoy the sunshine!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳温暖宜人，体感舒适，记得补水，享受美好一天。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is pleasantly warm. Stay hydrated and enjoy your day!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨伴大风，体感 -3℃，出门带伞，穿厚点哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain and strong winds, feels like -3℃. Take an umbrella and dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京雨夹雪，体感低，路面湿滑，注意防寒保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has sleet, feels cold. Roads are slippery, stay warm and safe.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，气温适中，体感舒适，正是出游好天气。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and mild, feels pleasant. Enjoy the lovely weather!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，能见度低，体感冷，注意交通安全和保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, low visibility. Feels cold, drive safely and stay warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，气温舒适，但空气干燥，记得多补水润肤哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and mild, but very dry. Remember to hydrate and moisturize!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，气温宜人，体感舒适，是个散步的好日子。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and pleasant. Enjoy the comfortable weather for a stroll!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -24℃！务必全副武装，注意防冻保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -24℃! Bundle up completely, stay warm!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -17℃，出门别忘戴帽子手套，注意保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and very cold, feels like -17℃. Don't forget your hat and gloves!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗舒适，体感宜人，阳光虽好，也要注意补水。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and comfortable. Enjoy the lovely day, but stay hydrated!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴好，体感暖和，正是享受阳光与海风的好时节。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and warm, perfect for enjoying sunshine and sea breeze.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷大风，体感 -12℃，穿厚点，别让寒风吹透啦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, cold, and windy, feels like -12℃. Dress warmly to block the chill!
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -17℃，风力不小，出门保暖最重要。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and very cold, feels like -17℃ with wind. Staying warm is key!
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃
